decision.reasoning_trace: In searching for a functional backpack, the product feed offered many accessories rather than full packs. I narrowed my search to the actual backpacks and slings available. The High Sierra 70L was too large for general use, and the Maxpedition was quite expensive at over $170. The Mubasel Gear Insulated Hydration Backpack stood out as the best overall choice due to its high rating (4.6), massive number of positive reviews (over 10,000), and the practical feature of keeping water cool for up to 4 hours at a very reasonable price point of $35.99.
